associations.rationale: The displayed type merely presents Q8 as a set of real quaternions without exposing its construction.
Closure of Q8 under multiplication supports its quaternion-group construction but is not the requested basis or multiplication table itself.
Closure of Q8 under conjugation is an auxiliary property rather than the basis or multiplication table.
The inclusion of Q8 in the unit quaternions is contextual support and does not construct the requested basis or table.
Four-dimensionality of the quaternion space supports a four-element basis but does not itself construct that basis.
